description: AI-camera services in Kerala are suspended due to the Finance department's delay in clearing ₹60 crore in pending bills.
body_lead: The Kerala Finance department’s delay in clearing Keltron’s quarterly bills has disrupted the services of AI-powered traffic cameras installed across the State. Internet services for the cameras were disconnected by the service provider, Jio, after Keltron failed to clear the dues of the private company responsible for the connectivity. The Finance department releases quarterly funds to Keltron through the Kerala Road Safety Authority (KRSA) for operating the facility. The KRSA, in turn, is responsible for paying the annuity bills to Keltron.
